title: Multi-turn turntable solver robustness: YCB mustard bottle and drill regression, 2026-10-11
inputs: YCB 006_mustard_bottle and 035_power_drill rgb_highres, cameras N1-N5, 60 photos each (6 degree steps), undistorted and resampled into one common pinhole lens from each camera's own intrinsics. Supplied poses, rig extrinsics, masks and depth not used for reconstruction; Google 64k scan only for scoring.

changes.unsolved_turn: with --turntable-rings > 1 a turn whose own solve fails is warned about and registered against the other turns
changes.turntable_model: resected turns put onto one camera turned about the shared axis (axis from the sound turns' rotations, axis point by exact pairwise least squares); photos >3 degrees off take their angle from neighbours
changes.constrained_adjustment: those turns keep their turntable motion in the joint bundle adjustment (fixed camera 6 parameters + one angle per photo); captures without such a turn use the unchanged adjustment
changes.deadlines: default deadlines multiplied by the number of turns; given deadlines kept
changes.per_turn_audit: per-photo audit reasons recomputed from each turn's own photos

mustard.masks: own background-contrast masks (cut cap, nozzle and parts of labels/lower body in steep views)
mustard.turn_5: no points triangulated from its own matches; registered against turns 1-4 and put on the turntable motion
mustard.rig_check_evaluation_only: distance camera 5 to camera 3 about 4.5 % too long (drill 0.2 %)
mustard.cause: not established; candidates weak cross-turn ties (median matches 24 for turns 3-4, 36 for 4-5; drill 58, 71) or short dense baselines between top-down views

drill_regression.note: differences within the alignment uncertainty of earlier runs

single_turn_identity: 2136 x 1424 drill N3 capture, background masks: ce9e637 binary and this one write the same 387 files, 382 byte-identical, the other five differ only in output paths and timings; dense stage unchanged
checks: clippy -D warnings all-targets default, capi, sam-onnx
not_done: browser execution of the multi-turn front end
